name: YouVersion Bible
description: Add YouVersion translations (NIV, NASB, AMP and many more) to the Scriptures sidebar. Search them there like any other translation: results show only the reference, and the text is fetched when you add one to the schedule or drag it there. It is kept only as long as the publisher allows (the NIV: two chapters or 25 verses at a time, whichever is greater; others up to five chapters), and is never saved into a schedule file. OpenSanctuary releases include a YouVersion key; you can use your own instead, kept in your computer's secure storage.

permissions.reason: Appears as a panel in the Bible library
The server asks the YouVersion Platform for the list of Bibles and for the passage you look up (adding the app's key, or your own in the X-YVP-App-Key header), and contacts no other host
Keeps your own YouVersion Platform App Key, if you choose to use one instead of the built-in key, in secure storage that only this plugin can read

Saves the passage you add (a chapter or part of one) in your Bible library so it can be shown, sealed and deleted when its publisher's time limit runs out; and saves which YouVersion translations you added to your sidebar (names only, no text). It can replace a saved passage of the same book, chapter, verses and version
Adds the passage you chose to the schedule, and fills in the text of passages on a schedule you opened by looking them up again
